issues.title: Projection resource limits conflate candidate work with actual output
issues.preChange: DuplicateOverlap was refused because 207,000 candidate encounters exceeded the unrelated 200,000 output/adjacency-derived effective limit.
issues.postChange: Independent candidate, unique-edge, support-reference, synchronous-work, adjacency, render, export, and matrix dimensions are reported. DuplicateOverlap computes 1,035 exact edges from 207,000 candidates and 207,000 retained support references.

issues.title: CC/BFS/DFS require a full V2V projection
issues.preChange: All three algorithms imported projected adjacency and failed on OneHugeEdge1K before traversal at 499,500 candidate pairs.
issues.postChange: Each algorithm builds one Stage 3 incidence index per run and lazily enumerates sorted logical V2V neighbors through incidence relations. No migrated path imports graphModel or projection.js.

issues.title: Projected pair identity is not collision-safe or totally ordered
issues.preChange: A NUL-joined key collapsed two distinct pairs, while numerically equal lexical IDs such as 01 and 1 could produce two opposite orientations.
issues.postChange: Nested Maps key exact endpoint strings without serialization, and numeric ties use an exact-string tie-breaker. NUL, numeric-lexical, prototype-like, literal-null, zero, Unicode, and reversed-membership cases pass.

issues.title: BFS/DFS animation traces retain quadratic result amplification
issues.disposition: Register for a later trace/performance architecture stage; Stage 4 preserves complete steps and does not silently truncate them.
